verdict.why: The right build reads as a pagoda with real character: layered roofs with stone-capped ridges, upturned eave tips, a stone plinth, and open colonnaded tiers, while the left is a plain stack of dark brown boxes with thin roof lips and little ornament. The right has some stray floating posts and spikes at the top, but the left's flatter, blockier massing reads weaker on a street.
